instruction_bn: প্রশ্নগুলোর উত্তর দিয়ে একটি paragraph লেখো। নিজে লেখার পর নমুনা ও checklist দেখো (Board: 15 marks)।

items.prompt: Write a paragraph about 'A Rainy Day' answering: (a) What is a rainy day? (b) How does the sky look? (c) What do people do? (d) How do the poor suffer? (e) How do you enjoy it?
items.model: A rainy day is a day when it rains from morning till night. On such a day the sky remains cloudy and dark, and the sun is hardly seen. It rains sometimes heavily and sometimes gently. During heavy rain the roads go under water and become muddy. Most people cannot go out and have to stay indoors. Offices, schools and markets wear a dull look. The day is a great trouble for the poor and the day labourers, because they cannot go to work and earn their living. Many of them pass the day half-fed or unfed. However, a rainy day is not without joy for children. They make paper boats and float them on water. Village boys catch fish in the muddy water. I enjoy a rainy day by reading storybooks and eating khichuri with my family.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph about 'A Book Fair' answering: (a) What is a book fair? (b) When and where is it held? (c) What is seen there? (d) Why is it useful? (e) What is your experience?
items.model: A book fair is a fair where different kinds of books are displayed and sold. In our country the biggest book fair, the Ekushey Boi Mela, is held in February at the Bangla Academy in Dhaka. Besides, many book fairs are arranged in schools and colleges throughout the year. In a book fair there are many stalls decorated with colourful books. Writers, publishers and readers of all ages gather there. One can find books on almost every subject, such as stories, novels, poems, science and history. A book fair is very useful because it creates interest in reading and helps to spread knowledge. It also gives writers and readers a chance to meet. Last February I visited the Ekushey Boi Mela with my friends. I bought some storybooks and enjoyed the day very much.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph about 'A Street Hawker' answering: (a) Who is a street hawker? (b) How does he look? (c) What does he sell? (d) How does he attract buyers? (e) How does he live?
items.model: A street hawker is a person who sells small things by moving from street to street. He is a familiar figure in both towns and villages. Usually he is poorly dressed and carries his goods in a basket or on a small cart. A street hawker sells many kinds of things such as toys, bangles, sweets, vegetables and cheap clothes. He is very clever in attracting buyers. He cries out in a sing-song voice to draw their attention and shows his goods in an interesting way. He often sells his things at a cheap rate, so women and children are his main customers. A street hawker leads a very hard life. He works from morning till evening and earns only a little. In spite of his hard labour, he can hardly maintain his family. We should be kind to him.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph about 'A Journey by Train' answering: (a) When did you travel? (b) Where did you go? (c) How was the station? (d) How did you feel during the journey? (e) What did you see outside?
items.model: A journey by train is always pleasant and comfortable. Last winter I made a journey by train from Dhaka to Sylhet with my family. We reached the railway station an hour before the departure time. The station was crowded with passengers of all kinds. Some were buying tickets while others were waiting on the platform. When the train arrived, we got into our compartment and took our seats. Soon the train started with a whistle. During the journey I felt very happy and excited. Through the window I saw green fields, rivers, trees and small villages running backward. Hawkers were selling tea and snacks in the train. The passengers were talking and enjoying the scenery. The journey was smooth and joyful. After a few hours we reached Sylhet safely. I shall never forget this pleasant journey by train.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph about 'Our National Flag' answering: (a) What is the national flag? (b) How does it look? (c) What does it mean? (d) When is it hoisted? (e) What is our duty to it?
items.model: The national flag is the symbol of a free and independent nation. Every free country has its own national flag, and so has Bangladesh. Our national flag is rectangular in shape. It is bottle green in colour with a round red disc in the middle. The green colour stands for the greenery and youth of our country, while the red disc stands for the blood of the martyrs and the rising sun of hope. Our national flag was won at the cost of the lives of millions of people in 1971. It is hoisted on all government buildings, schools and colleges on our national days such as Independence Day and Victory Day. It fills our hearts with joy and pride. It is our sacred duty to keep the honour of our national flag. We should be ready to sacrifice even our lives for it.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph about 'The International Mother Language Day' answering: (a) What is it? (b) When is it observed? (c) Why is it important? (d) How is it observed? (e) What does it teach us?
items.model: The International Mother Language Day is observed on the 21st of February every year. It is a red-letter day in the history of Bangladesh. On this day in 1952, Salam, Barkat, Rafiq, Jabbar and many others laid down their lives for the honour of our mother tongue, Bangla. They protested against the decision to make Urdu the only state language of Pakistan. In memory of their great sacrifice, UNESCO declared 21st February as the International Mother Language Day in 1999. Now the day is observed all over the world. On this day people go to the Shaheed Minar barefoot early in the morning and place flowers there to show respect to the martyrs. Special programmes are held and the national flag is kept at half-mast. The day teaches us to love our mother tongue and to respect other languages too.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph about 'A Moonlit Night' answering: (a) What is a moonlit night? (b) How does nature look? (c) How do people pass the time? (d) How do you feel? (e) Why do you like it?
items.model: A moonlit night is a night when the moon shines brightly in the sky. It is one of the most beautiful sights of nature. On such a night the full moon spreads its soft silvery light all around. The sky looks clear and the stars twinkle beside the moon. Trees, rivers and fields look charming in the moonlight. The whole world seems to be bathed in silver. On a moonlit night people come out of their houses to enjoy the beauty of nature. Children play in the open field, and elderly people sit together and chat. In villages people arrange jari, sari and other folk songs. A moonlit night fills my heart with a strange joy and peace. I like it very much because of its calm and gentle beauty. I often sit on the roof and gaze at the moon.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph about 'Environment Pollution' answering: (a) What is environment pollution? (b) What are its main types? (c) What are its causes? (d) What harm does it do? (e) How can it be checked?
items.model: Environment pollution means the contamination of our natural surroundings, that is, the air, water and soil. It has become a serious problem all over the world. There are mainly three types of pollution: air pollution, water pollution and soil pollution. Air is polluted by smoke from mills, factories and vehicles. Water is polluted by waste, chemicals and human refuse. Soil is polluted by harmful chemicals and unplanned use of fertilisers. Environment pollution does great harm to us. It causes many diseases and destroys the balance of nature. If it is not checked, our very existence will be in danger. Pollution can be checked in many ways. We should plant more trees and stop the reckless cutting of trees. Mills and factories should be set up far from towns. We must also raise public awareness to keep our environment clean and safe.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph about 'Wonders of Modern Science' answering: (a) What has science given us? (b) How has it helped in communication? (c) How has it helped in medicine? (d) How has it helped in daily life? (e) How should we use it?
items.model: Modern science has worked wonders in our life. It has given us many wonderful things that our forefathers could not even dream of. In the field of communication, science has removed distance. Now we can talk to people of distant countries within a moment through the mobile phone and the internet. Aeroplanes and fast trains carry us from one place to another quickly. In the field of medicine, science has conquered many fatal diseases. Doctors can now treat patients with modern machines and medicines. In our daily life, electricity, the fan, the refrigerator and the television have made our life easy and comfortable. In fact, science serves us in every step of life. But science can also be misused to destroy the world. So, we should use science only for the welfare of mankind.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph about 'Tree Plantation Programme' answering: (a) What is it? (b) Why are trees important? (c) When and where should we plant trees? (d) What is its role in our economy? (e) What should we do?
items.model: A tree plantation programme means planting trees in a planned way in open and empty spaces. Trees are very important for our life and existence. They give us oxygen, food, fruits, wood and shade. They also keep the balance of nature, prevent floods and cause rainfall. The best time for planting trees in our country is the rainy season, because young plants get enough water then. We can plant trees on both sides of roads, around houses, schools and offices and on fallow land. Tree plantation plays a great role in our economy, as timber, fruits and other products earn money. If we cut down trees without planting new ones, our country will turn into a desert. So, we should all take part in the tree plantation programme and plant more trees than we cut.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph about 'Discipline' answering: (a) What is discipline? (b) Where do we see it? (c) Why is it important? (d) What happens without it? (e) How can we be disciplined?
items.model: Discipline means obedience to certain rules and regulations. It is one of the most important things in life. We see discipline everywhere in nature. The sun rises in the east and sets in the west every day. The seasons come and go in a fixed order. Discipline is important in every walk of life. Without it, no family, school or nation can run smoothly. An army wins battles only through discipline. If there is no discipline, there will be disorder and confusion everywhere, and no work can be done properly. We can be disciplined by following the rules of our home, school and society. A student should study, eat, sleep and play at the right time. He should obey his parents and teachers. Thus, we should practise discipline from our childhood to build a happy and peaceful life.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph about 'A Village Fair' answering: (a) What is a village fair? (b) When is it held? (c) What is sold there? (d) What entertainments are there? (e) How do people enjoy it?
items.model: A village fair is a part of our rural culture and tradition. It is usually held on some special occasions like Pahela Baishakh or on the bank of a river or an open field. Most fairs sit once or twice a year and last for a day or a few days. Many things are sold in a village fair. There are stalls of sweets, toys, bangles, earthen pots, cane goods and various kinds of food. Different kinds of entertainments are also arranged there. One can enjoy jatra, puppet shows, magic shows and the merry-go-round. People of all ages, especially women and children, come to the fair in colourful dresses. They buy things and enjoy the fun with great delight. A village fair gives us a taste of joy and brings people closer. It reflects the age-old culture of rural Bengal.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph about 'Importance of Reading Newspaper' answering: (a) What is a newspaper? (b) What does it contain? (c) Why should we read it? (d) What are its bad sides? (e) What is your opinion?
items.model: A newspaper is a printed paper that brings us the news of home and abroad. It is a storehouse of knowledge and information. A newspaper contains news of politics, sports, business, education and many other things. It also has articles, advertisements and the opinions of learned people. We should read newspapers regularly for many reasons. By reading a newspaper we can know what is happening around the world. It helps us form our own opinion on different matters and makes us good citizens. A man without a newspaper is like a frog in a well. However, a newspaper has some bad sides too. Sometimes it spreads false news and rumours that mislead people. In my opinion, the good sides of a newspaper are far greater than its bad sides. So, everyone should form the habit of reading newspapers daily.
rubric: ভালো ও খারাপ দিক দুটিই লিখেছি
grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph about 'A Winter Morning' answering: (a) What is a winter morning? (b) How does it look? (c) How do people feel? (d) What special foods are eaten? (e) How do you like it?
items.model: A winter morning is a cold and foggy morning of the winter season. It is quite different from the mornings of other seasons. In the early hours everything remains covered with a thick blanket of fog. Things at a little distance cannot be seen clearly. Dewdrops fall on grass and leaves and shine like pearls when the sun rises. In a winter morning people feel very cold. They wrap themselves in warm clothes. The poor people who have no warm clothes suffer greatly. Some of them make fires with straw and dry leaves to warm themselves. In villages people enjoy date juice and delicious cakes made of new rice in a winter morning. Farmers and workers wait for the sun to rise. When the sun comes up, the fog slowly disappears. I like a winter morning very much for its calm beauty and tasty cakes.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph about 'Dengue Fever' answering: (a) What is dengue? (b) How does it spread? (c) What are its symptoms? (d) How is it harmful? (e) How can we prevent it?
items.model: Dengue is a fatal fever caused by a virus. It has become a serious health problem in our country in recent years. Dengue fever spreads through the bite of a special kind of mosquito called Aedes. This mosquito breeds in clean and stagnant water and usually bites during the daytime. The symptoms of dengue are high fever, severe headache, pain in the joints and muscles, and sometimes bleeding. In serious cases the number of blood platelets falls dangerously. Dengue is very harmful and may even cause death if not treated in time. However, we can prevent dengue by taking some steps. We should not allow water to collect anywhere near our house. We should keep our surroundings clean and use mosquito nets and sprays. If anyone shows the symptoms, he should see a doctor at once. Public awareness is the best way to prevent dengue.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph about 'A Tea Stall' answering: (a) What is a tea stall? (b) Where is it found? (c) How does it look? (d) Who gather there? (e) What is its importance?
items.model: A tea stall is a small shop where tea and light refreshments are sold. It is a very common sight in our country. A tea stall is found almost everywhere, at bus stands, railway stations, markets, road crossings and in villages. It is usually a small shop made of tin or bamboo. Inside there are a few benches and tables and a stove for making tea. Biscuits, bread, banana and cakes are kept in glass cases. People of all classes gather at a tea stall. They come here to take tea and to gossip in their leisure time. Here people talk about politics, sports and current affairs over a cup of tea. Thus a tea stall is not only a place of refreshment but also a centre of meeting and discussion. A tea stall is important because it gives us rest and news and provides a living for the owner.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph about 'Victory Day' answering: (a) What is Victory Day? (b) When is it observed? (c) Why is it important? (d) How is it celebrated? (e) What does it remind us of?
items.model: Victory Day is one of the most important national days of Bangladesh. It is observed on the 16th of December every year. On this day in 1971 our brave freedom fighters defeated the Pakistani army after a nine-month bloody war. Bangladesh was born as an independent country at the cost of the lives of millions of martyrs. That is why Victory Day is so important to us. The day is celebrated with great enthusiasm all over the country. Early in the morning people place wreaths at the National Memorial at Savar to show respect to the martyrs. The national flag is hoisted on the top of every building. Parades, cultural functions and games are arranged. Newspapers publish special supplements and television channels telecast special programmes. Victory Day reminds us of the great sacrifice of our freedom fighters. It inspires us to build a happy and prosperous country.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph about 'Pahela Baishakh' answering: (a) What is Pahela Baishakh? (b) When is it observed? (c) How is it celebrated? (d) What is the Mangal Shobhajatra? (e) What does it mean to us?
items.model: Pahela Baishakh is the first day of the Bengali New Year. It is one of the biggest festivals of the Bengali nation. It is observed on the first day of the month of Baishakh, that is, on the 14th of April. The day is celebrated with great joy all over the country. People wear traditional dresses; girls put on colourful saris and boys wear panjabi. In the early morning people take part in cultural programmes and sing 'Esho he Baishakh'. Baishakhi fairs sit in many places where various local goods and foods are sold. People enjoy panta-ilish and different sweets. A colourful procession called the Mangal Shobhajatra is brought out, especially in Dhaka, carrying masks and images. Pahela Baishakh means a fresh start to us. It reflects our culture and unites people of all religions in a spirit of joy and brotherhood.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph about 'Uses and Abuses of the Internet' answering: (a) What is the internet? (b) How is it useful? (c) How is it abused? (d) Who are most affected? (e) How should we use it?
items.model: The internet is one of the greatest wonders of modern science. It is a huge network that connects millions of computers all over the world. The internet is very useful in our daily life. Through it we can get information on any subject within a moment. Students can learn many things, attend online classes and prepare for their examinations. Businessmen can buy and sell goods online, and people can communicate with one another easily. But the internet is also abused in many ways. Some people spread false news and rumours, while others waste their valuable time playing games and using social media. Young students are most affected, as many of them become addicted to it. Therefore, we should be careful about the use of the internet. We should use it for our study and knowledge, not for any harmful purpose. Then it will be a real blessing for us.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph about 'Deforestation' answering: (a) What is deforestation? (b) Why do people cut trees? (c) What harm does it cause? (d) How does it affect climate? (e) What should we do?
items.model: Deforestation means cutting down trees and forests without any plan. It has become a great threat to our environment. People cut down trees for many reasons. They need wood for fuel, furniture and houses. They also clear forests to make room for farming, industries and new settlements. But deforestation causes great harm to us. It destroys the balance of nature and the homes of many birds and animals. It also causes floods, droughts and soil erosion. Deforestation has a bad effect on the climate as well. When trees are cut down, the amount of carbon dioxide in the air increases and the temperature of the earth rises. This leads to climate change and global warming. To save our environment, we must stop cutting trees carelessly. We should plant more and more trees and raise awareness among the people. Only then can we ensure a green and safe world.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে

items.prompt: Write a paragraph about 'A School Magazine' answering: (a) What is a school magazine? (b) What does it contain? (c) Who write in it? (d) Why is it useful? (e) What is your view?
items.model: A school magazine is a magazine published by a school. It usually comes out once a year. A school magazine contains stories, poems, essays, jokes and reports of different events of the school. It also carries the results and achievements of the students. Both teachers and students write in a school magazine. Talented students get a chance to publish their writings in it. A school magazine is very useful for the students. It helps to develop the talent of writing among them. It removes their shyness and encourages them to be creative. It also keeps a record of the yearly activities of the school. Besides, it creates a bond of love among the students and teachers. In my view, every school should publish a magazine regularly. It is a mirror that reflects the life and spirit of a school.
rubric: grammar ও বানান ঠিক আছে, ১৫০+ শব্দ হয়েছে
